baslik: The Factory Wastewater That Poisoned a Fishing Town

sahneler.metin: In a Japanese fishing town, people began to suffer a mysterious disease.
Some were killed, and thousands were left disabled.
Cats in the town were affected first.
A chemical factory was releasing methylmercury into the bay.
Small organisms absorbed it, then fish ate them.
Mercury built up at each step of the food chain.
People who ate the fish received toxic doses.
A global treaty on mercury now bears Minamata's name.

aciklama:
Minamata poisoned people who ate its fish. The cause: bioaccumulation of methylmercury through the marine food chain.
